request.deadline: 12 months from deployment; month-6 yield return; audit expected by July 1, 2026
deliverables: Deploy 9,000,000 ADA sold for USDM into Strike Finance V2 liquidity infrastructure for 12 months
Return realized yield from the first six months to the Cardano Treasury at month 6
Return 100% of treasury-owned deployed assets, including remaining principal and realized yield, at month 12

Provide monthly public transparency reports covering deployment status, liquidity utilization, volume, open interest, profit and loss, yield, drawdown, stablecoin exposure, market quality metrics, distributions, and material risks
Provide third-party assurance reports for deployment confirmation, month-6 yield distribution, and month-12 return of funds
request.recipient: Independent council composed of Rami from Snek, Phil from Surf, and James from Monetra/Moneta as administrator and multisig overseer
request.what: 12-month productive treasury deployment into Strike Finance V2 liquidity infrastructure by selling ADA for USDM to provide stablecoin-denominated liquidity

claims.claim: The proposal requests 9,000,000 ADA for a 12-month liquidity deployment into Strike Finance V2 rather than grant funding.
The deployed ADA will be sold for USDM, with modeling assuming ADA equals 0.15 USD and producing approximately 1,350,000 USDM of stablecoin liquidity.

Under modeled assumptions of a 10% USD-denominated annual percentage rate, the deployment is expected to generate about 135,000 USD or 900,000 ADA-equivalent in annual yield, but returns are not guaranteed.

Strike reports more than 1.13 billion USD in cumulative volume, about 968,000 to 1,001,000 trades, more than 3,000 unique traders, over 1.16 million USD in protocol revenue, and over 3.25 million USD in liquidity provider profit.

Strike V2 data from 2026-03-20 through 2026-06-15 is presented as showing 87,288,044 USD total V2 volume, 410,800 total V2 trades, 2,681 users, 30,105 USD total V2 revenue, and 1,246,007 USD peak open interest.

The proposal claims Strike's liquidity provider vault has 985,271.59 USD total value locked, 43.52% APR, +8.85% all-time return, 1.15% maximum drawdown, and a 4.97 Sharpe ratio after two months of public performance history.
Operational custody is proposed to be handled by an independent multisig council, and Strike Finance will not have unilateral custody or control of treasury assets.
The proposal identifies risks including ADA price appreciation risk, USDM depeg or redemption risk, smart contract risk, yield underperformance, liquidity risk, and custody or operational risk.

Governance review is triggered if drawdown exceeds 8%, reporting is missed for two consecutive monthly cycles, or unresolved custody, accounting, stablecoin, redemption, or smart contract concerns arise, with mandatory review at 10% drawdown and a separate early-termination review at 20% drawdown.

The proposal states that Strike V2 has had unofficial reviews and that Christian Schmitz is conducting an official audit expected to be finalized by July 1, 2026, with the report to be published upon completion.

summary: The document requests 9,000,000 ADA for a 12-month treasury-owned Strike Finance V2 liquidity deployment, models yield from converting ADA to USDM, cites significant Strike adoption and vault performance metrics, proposes independent multisig custody and reporting, and acknowledges market, stablecoin, smart contract, yield, and custody risks.
